description.value: Big Star Sandwich Co. is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013, built around hearty house-crafted sandwiches on fresh rustic Filone bread. Their meats — including slow-roasted in-house beef and hand-pulled turkey — are prepared fresh daily, making for a genuinely filling stop. With six locations across the region and online ordering available, it's a reliable option for a substantial eat-in or takeout meal.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack at 41m; stands at 52m; rack at 79m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms the New Westminster location at 664 Columbia St with phone (604) 521-0019, matching OSM exactly. Takeout is explicitly supported by 'Delivery & Pickup', 'Order Online', and 'whether you eat in or take out' on the website; OSM also confirms indoor_seating=yes. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those are null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, multi-location sandwich restaurant confirmed active at this address by its own website. A solid food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes, but the website does not explicitly confirm vegetarian or vegan menu items; marked null pending direct menu confirmation.

wow_evidence: Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013... six locations across the region
